_comment: 1.11.1 KC3/KC4 fixtures for the cookie gate. 'real' holds a saved anonymous curl -sI response (values replaced with 'x', attributes kept verbatim, no site-specific meaning asserted by the tests beyond the generic RFC rules). 'constructed' are RFC 6265 edge cases used to test is_deletion()/plan() as a general rule, not a specific vendor.

real.note: Anonymous front-page GET set no cookies at all on this request.
One real Set-Cookie line, value replaced with x, attributes kept as sent.
lines: Set-Cookie: partner-ads-query=x; expires=Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:52:58 GMT; Max-Age=3456000; path=/

constructed.name: max_age_positive_with_past_expires
constructed.description: A valid positive Max-Age has precedence over an Expires in the past: not a deletion.

constructed.name: invalid_max_age_no_expires
constructed.description: An invalid Max-Age never counts as a deletion by itself.

constructed.name: invalid_max_age_with_future_expires
constructed.description: Max-Age is invalid, so Expires is consulted; it is in the future, so not a deletion.

constructed.name: invalid_max_age_with_past_expires
constructed.description: Max-Age is invalid, so Expires is consulted; it is in the past, so this is a deletion.

constructed.name: deletion_max_age_negative
constructed.description: A negative Max-Age is a deletion.

constructed.name: deletion_via_expires_only
constructed.description: No Max-Age at all, Expires in the past: a deletion.

constructed.name: no_max_age_future_expires
constructed.description: No Max-Age, Expires in the future: not a deletion.

constructed.name: no_expiry_attributes_at_all
constructed.description: Session cookie (no Max-Age, no Expires): never a deletion.

constructed.name: host_prefixed_name
constructed.description: The __Host- prefix is part of the cookie name.

constructed.name: secure_prefixed_name
constructed.description: The __Secure- prefix is part of the cookie name.

constructed.name: duplicate_name_first
constructed.description: Two Set-Cookie lines for the same name are handled independently (first: not a deletion).

constructed.name: duplicate_name_second_is_deletion
constructed.description: Two Set-Cookie lines for the same name are handled independently (second: a deletion).

constructed.name: invalid_cookie_name
constructed.description: No '=' at all: not a valid cookie name, must be kept.
